name: OFDM: the message is the grid
why: Nothing about the structure is in the capture — the FFT size, the cyclic prefix and the symbol period are all recovered from the signal by correlating it against itself at each plausible lag, which is the one thing a cyclic prefix makes possible and nothing else in a signal does. The occupancy pattern spells SDR, so a grid that comes back with the symbol boundaries even slightly wrong smears the letters and fails visibly rather than subtly.
note: The chain ends in a grid rather than in records, so the assertions live in web/test/ofdm.test.mjs. This entry exists so the capture is regenerated, size-checked and licensed with the rest.
